## The binding claim rule (this row's core AC)

`docs/build/tools/record_policy/live_claims.toml` requires a
`sig.probe-run/1` record ≤24 h (10 min skew) for any production-state
assertion on a corpus surface. The newest committed probe is
`docs/build/reports/probes/p37.61a-harm-republish-post.json`
(2026-11-16T09:42:48Z) — **stale at refresh time (2026-11-23)**. So:

- **No new unqualified production assertion was written.** Every added
  line is assert-free or pairs the assert token with a bounding word in
  the same segment (`queued`, `gated`, `prepared_not_executed`,
  `nothing`, `stays`, "as recorded").
- **Grandfathered claims stay verbatim** — the policy reports the 113
  pre-existing dated claims (109 after four stale segments were
  de-classified by their bounding rewrites); rewriting them requires a
  fresh probe a docs row cannot run.
- **Nothing claims the schema deploy, export/re-cut chain, release
  registry or promote chain is green.** The docs record the
  queued/blocked posture per the 2026-11-20 LEDGER PHASE LOG entry
  (`OPS-SPINE-SCHEMA-DEPLOY` FAILED CLEAN — 19/41 applied, all reverted,
  poststate == prestate) and `OPERATIONAL_READINESS.md` §(g).
